people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: He had a son, whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a better person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.
translations.bsb: And he had a son named Saul, choice and handsome, without equal among the Israelites—a head taller than any of the people.
translations.kjv: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a choice young man, and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.
translations.asv: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a young man and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.
